# runr_project (Resource)

A RunR project: a function (`faas`), a single-file script (`xaas`) or a container (`caas`) in a region. Code is uploaded with `runr deploy`; container images and deployments can be managed with `runr_deployment`.

A config change saves a new project version; running deployments pick it up when they are redeployed (see `runr_deployment.triggers`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "runr_region" "eu" {
  name = "eu-1"
}

# A Python function; its code is uploaded with `runr deploy`.
resource "runr_project" "api" {
  name      = "orders-api"
  type      = "faas"
  runtime   = "python"
  region_id = data.runr_region.eu.id
  handler   = "main.handler"

  resources = {
    cpu             = "250m"
    memory_mb       = 256
    timeout_seconds = 30
  }

  scale = {
    min     = 0
    max     = 10
    to_zero = true
  }

  trigger = {
    type = "http"
  }
}

# A nightly job.
resource "runr_project" "report" {
  name      = "nightly-report"
  type      = "faas"
  runtime   = "nodejs"
  region_id = data.runr_region.eu.id

  trigger = {
    type     = "schedule"
    schedule = "0 2 * * *"
  }
}

# A container.
resource "runr_project" "web" {
  name      = "web"
  type      = "caas"
  region_id = data.runr_region.eu.id
  image     = "ghcr.io/acme/web:1.4.2"
  ports     = [8080]

  # Let runr_deployment (or CI) roll out new images.
  lifecycle {
    ignore_changes = [image]
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Project name; its slug names the service and the default URL. Changing it creates a new project.
- `region_id` (String) Region id (`data.runr_region`). Changing it moves the project.
- `type` (String) `faas`, `xaas` or `caas`. Changing it creates a new project.

### Optional

- `args` (List of String) `caas`: arguments.
- `command` (List of String) `caas`: entrypoint override.
- `description` (String) Free text.
- `filename` (String) `xaas`: the script file (default `main.<ext>`).
- `handler` (String) `faas`: `file.function` (default `main.handler` → `main.py`, `def handler`). `xaas`: the function name (default `handler`).
- `image` (String) `caas`: container image. Required when the project is created.
- `ports` (List of Number) `caas`: container ports; the first serves HTTP (default 80).
- `resources` (Attributes) Container limits. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))
- `runtime` (String) Runtime of `faas`/`xaas` projects: `python`, `nodejs`, `go`, `php`, … Changing it creates a new project.
- `runtime_version` (String) Runtime version; default the platform's default version. Changing it creates a new project.
- `scale` (Attributes) Autoscaling range. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scale))
- `trigger` (Attributes) What starts the code. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--trigger))

### Read-Only

- `endpoint_url` (String) Public URL (HTTP trigger).
- `id` (String) Project id.
- `latest_version_id` (String) Id of the newest version.
- `slug` (String) Slug derived from the name.

<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Optional:

- `cpu` (String) Kubernetes CPU quantity (`100m`, `0.5`).
- `memory_mb` (Number) Memory in MB (at least 64).
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Request timeout in seconds.


<a id="nestedatt--scale"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scale`

Optional:

- `max` (Number) Maximum instances (1-1000).
- `min` (Number) Minimum instances (0-10).
- `to_zero` (Boolean) Scale to zero instances when idle.


<a id="nestedatt--trigger"></a>
### Nested Schema for `trigger`

Optional:

- `queue` (String) Redis stream of a `queue` trigger (the region needs Redis).
- `schedule` (String) Cron expression of a `schedule` trigger, e.g. `*/5 * * * *`.
- `type` (String) `http` (default), `schedule` or `queue`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A project is imported by name or id.
terraform import runr_project.api orders-api
```
